page_title: LAZ 1-0 CAG | Lazio v Cagliari 02/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari) runs onto the ball and hits a thunderbolt of a shot at goal from the edge of the box, but sends it narrowly wide of the right post.
90+4' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the left-hand post.
90+3' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Lazio was in an offside position.
90+2' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
90+2' Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
90+1' Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the left post, but Ivan Provedel is prepared and dives to thwart him.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
89' Federico Dionisi interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari). That's a free kick to Lazio.
88' Here comes a substitution. Matteo Prati is given a rest as he is replaced by Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari).
85' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
83' Here is a change. Gustav Isaksen is going off and Maurizio Sarri gives the last tactical orders to Matias Vecino (Lazio).
83' Substitution. Edoardo Goldaniga is replaced by Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari).
78' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
75' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) launches a cross from the corner, but Simone Scuffet is alert to thwart the effort.
75' Having seen unsporting behavior, Federico Dionisi shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) is the recipient.
74' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. Lazio have been awarded a corner kick.

71' It's unbelievable, Taty Castellanos (Lazio) blows a huge opportunity! He is totally unmarked and fires a first-time shot towards the left post from a few yards out, but Simone Scuffet reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
70' Maurizio Sarri prepares a substitution. Ciro Immobile is replaced by Taty Castellanos (Lazio).
70' Substitution. Felipe Anderson (Lazio) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Pedro walks off.
69' Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
69' The free kick is delivered by Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared. The referee points to the corner flag and Cagliari will take a corner.
68' Adam Marusic (Lazio) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. Cagliari have been awarded a free kick.
67' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
65' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
64' Federico Dionisi blows his whistle for a foul after Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) hacks down one of his opponents.
60' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) sends it out of play.
60' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Lazio earn a corner.
58' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Simone Scuffet intercepts the ball.
56' Problems for Maurizio Sarri as Luis Alberto (Lazio) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Daichi Kamada replaces him.
56' Luis Alberto (Lazio) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
54' The corner kick from Luis Alberto (Lazio) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
53' A rebound sits up perfectly for Matteo Prati (Cagliari), who connects nicely with the ball from mid-range but sends it miles wide of the right post.
51' Ciro Immobile (Lazio) makes a good run with the ball into the box, but mishits his shot as it goes well wide of the right post.
51' Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi (Cagliari) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.

50' A nice pass finds Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) in space. He sets himself up and hammers in a fantastic low shot from distance that looks bound for the middle of the goal, but the out of position Simone Scuffet pulls off a breathtaking save to deny him.
48' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
46' The game is over for Nicolo Rovella (Lazio). Danilo Cataldi comes on for the second half.
46' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari) comes onto the pitch so that Nicolas Viola can be given a rest.
46' Referee Federico Dionisi blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' Ciro Immobile (Lazio) is adjudged offside.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.

45' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Federico Dionisi with no other option than to blow for a foul.
41' Some great controlled play and passing from Cagliari. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
37' The linesman signals that Pedro (Lazio) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
32' Claudio Ranieri decides to make a substitution. Pantelis Hatzidiakos will be replaced by Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari).
32' A substitution has been made. Gianluca Lapadula goes off and Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) comes on.
28' The free kick from the edge of the box is taken by Gustav Isaksen (Lazio), who fires in a direct effort just wide of the right post. What a chance!
27' After VAR review the ref signals the yellow card is cancelled but now issues a red. Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) has to leave the pitch!

26' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari), but referee Federico Dionisi must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
25' Tempers flare after a clattering challenge by Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari), who receives a yellow card from the referee. It could have been worse for him!
23' Pedro (Lazio) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads inside the right post, but Simone Scuffet shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.

23' What a poor attempt! Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes yards wide of the left post.
21' Andrea Petagna (Cagliari) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His effort towards the left post is saved by Ivan Provedel.
19' Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) latches onto a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but sends his header miles wide of the right post.
17' Ciro Immobile (Lazio) and Pedro try to prise open the opposition with a series of short passes, but one of the defenders steps in and puts an end to the move.
13' Luis Alberto (Lazio) fires the resulting free kick to the top right corner from the edge of the box, but Simone Scuffet pulls off a superb save to deny him.
12' Lazio have a free kick from a promising distance.
12' Pantelis Hatzidiakos (Cagliari) commits a nasty foul by bringing down his opponent.
11' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) controls a poor pass, breaks past an opponent then slices an effort from mid-range well wide of the right post.
8' 1 - 0 Goal! Manuel Lazzari plays a simple square pass into the feet of Pedro (Lazio) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
6' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
5' Luis Alberto (Lazio) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

5' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Good work from Lazio as they win a corner.
4' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
2' One of the players from Lazio times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Lazio will kick the game off.
Federico Dionisi got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
